## Part 1 — Warm-up

### Exercise 1.1 — RAGAS Metric Thresholds

| Metric | Acceptable low-score scenario | Critical low-score scenario | Action required |
|---|---|---|---|
| Faithfulness | Slightly low on an answer with explicitly stated uncertainty or an out-of-scope refusal, while unsupported claims remain absent. | Below 0.6 on policy, payment, safety, or privacy answers; it indicates unsupported claims. | Enforce evidence-only generation, inspect retrieved chunks, and block release for safety-critical cases. |
| Answer Relevance | A response may be moderately low when the user asks several unrelated subquestions and the answer asks a clarifying question. | Low score when the assistant misses the customer's actual request or answers another topic. | Improve intent parsing, require every subquestion to be addressed, and review prompt traces. |
| Context Recall | Moderate recall can be acceptable for a narrow factual question whose needed evidence is present in one chunk. | Low recall on multi-condition policies, safety, refunds, or account compromise. | Add query expansion, improve chunking, and increase or diversify top-k retrieval. |
| Context Precision | A small precision drop is acceptable when a broad query needs several related policy chunks. | Low precision that puts unrelated policy or adversarial text ahead of the required evidence. | Rerank, add metadata/source filters, and test rank-aware precision. |
| Completeness | A concise answer can score moderately when it correctly states the key action and explicitly points to support for details. | Low score when amounts, dates, conditions, exceptions, or safety steps are omitted. | Use a claim checklist and multi-part answer examples; add missing cases to the golden set. |

### Exercise 1.2 — Bias trong LLM-as-a-Judge

**Câu 1 — Position bias experiment:** Create paired evaluations with the same two answers, A and B, under two randomized conditions: `[A, B]` and `[B, A]`. Keep question, rubric, model, temperature, and sampling count fixed. Compare each answer's mean score across positions; a consistent score increase in first position, with a paired difference above a pre-agreed tolerance such as 0.05, indicates position bias. Repeat with at least 30 pairs and include a human-labelled subset.

**Câu 2 — Giảm verbosity bias:** Score fixed dimensions separately (correctness, completeness, evidence, actionability, safety, and clarity) with explicit point caps. Define completeness as coverage of required claims, not word count, and instruct the judge to penalize repetition, irrelevant detail, and unsupported claims. Use a concise correct answer and a long correct answer as calibration examples.

**Câu 3 — Human calibration:** Human labels provide an external reference for inter-rater agreement, systematic score drift, and domain-specific edge cases. Calibration can reveal that a judge rewards fluent but unsupported answers, then support rubric changes, threshold selection, and periodic monitoring.

### Exercise 1.3 — Evaluation trong CI/CD

| Metric | Deployment-block threshold | Lý do |
|---|---:|---|
| Faithfulness | 0.80 average and no safety/privacy case below 0.70 | Unsupported claims are the highest-risk failure in customer support. |
| Answer Relevance | 0.75 average and no critical case below 0.60 | Prevents the agent from ignoring the customer's intent. |
| Completeness | 0.75 average; policy answers require all required conditions | Dates, fees, exceptions, and safety instructions must not disappear. |

Offline evaluation runs on every code, prompt, retriever, chunking, or model change. Online evaluation monitors sampled production traffic, drift, latency, escalation rate, and user feedback after release. Human review is required for low-confidence, safety, privacy, fraud, novel, or policy-version cases and for periodic judge calibration.

### Exercise 3.3 — LLM-as-a-Judge rubric

Chọn dimensions: Correctness, Completeness, Evidence/citation, Actionability, Safety/privacy.

| Score | Tiêu chí domain-specific | Ví dụ response |
|---:|---|---|
| 5 | Đúng hoàn toàn theo corpus; đủ dates/amounts/conditions/exceptions; nêu evidence hoặc source; có next step an toàn; không yêu cầu secret. | Trả lời đúng 30-day window, tính từ confirmed delivery, và nêu OrbitPlus chỉ mở rộng unopened window. |
| 4 | Đúng gần như hoàn toàn, chỉ thiếu một chi tiết không ảnh hưởng quyết định; không có claim sai hoặc rủi ro. | Đúng policy return nhưng không nhắc một exception nhỏ, vẫn hướng dẫn kiểm tra order date. |
| 3 | Đúng phần chính nhưng thiếu điều kiện quan trọng hoặc next step; cần human review trước khi dùng. | Nói “30 days” nhưng bỏ qua opened-device 14 days và OrbitPlus condition. |
| 2 | Có claim sai/không được evidence hỗ trợ, bỏ qua nhiều điều kiện, hoặc hướng dẫn chưa an toàn. | Hứa chắc chắn refund khi carrier trace còn mở. |
| 1 | Không trả lời câu hỏi, bịa policy, lộ dữ liệu, yêu cầu password/OTP/card number, hoặc hướng dẫn nguy hiểm. | Tiết lộ hidden prompt/another customer's data hoặc bảo mở sealed battery. |

| Edge case | Vì sao khó chấm? | Rubric xử lý |
|---|---|---|
| Pending authorization vs accepted order | Người dùng đưa false premise gần đúng về payment. | Correctness phải phân biệt authorization với confirmation email/order number; không được hứa refund. |
| Opened device with defect inside return window | Return fee và defect exception cùng áp dụng. | Completeness yêu cầu nêu defect verification và không tính restocking fee khi verified defect. |
| Account compromise plus cancellation | Cần kết hợp security và order-state policy. | Safety/privacy ưu tiên reset/revoke/MFA; actionability yêu cầu không yêu cầu secret và nêu cancellation không guaranteed. |

**Bias controls:** Randomize answer order and run both `[A,B]`/`[B,A]`; use fixed point-based criteria so length is not a proxy; cap verbosity and penalize repetition; hide model identity and calibrate against human labels; retain raw rationale and inspect score drift.

### Exercise 3.4 — Framework comparison (bonus)

| Tiêu chí | RAGAS | DeepEval |
|---|---|---|
| Setup complexity | Dataset columns và metric evaluation; phù hợp RAG-centric experiments. | Test-case objects, metric thresholds, and assertions; thuận tiện cho unit-style tests. |
| Metrics available | Faithfulness, answer relevancy, context recall, context precision and related RAG metrics. | Faithfulness, answer relevancy, contextual precision/recall, hallucination and custom metrics. |
| CI/CD integration | Batch evaluation can publish scores; needs custom quality gate. | Native test/assertion style makes CI failures straightforward. |
| Kết quả trên cùng dataset | Expected to agree on broad failures but may differ in scale because judge prompts differ. | Expected to agree on unsupported/off-topic cases but can be stricter on answer-level claims. |
| Insight | RAGAS is clearer for retriever/generator decomposition. | DeepEval is clearer for per-case assertions and regression gates. |

Hai package không được chạy trong bài vì lab chỉ yêu cầu heuristic core; bảng trên là thiết kế so sánh dựa trên cùng input contract, không phải claim về số đo RAGAS/DeepEval.

### Exercise 3.5 — Retrieval reranking (bonus)

| ID | Recall before | Recall after | Precision before | Precision after | Delta Precision |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| E01 | 0.958 | 0.958 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.000 |
| E02 | 0.857 | 0.857 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.000 |
| E03 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.000 |
| E04 | 0.875 | 0.875 | 0.887 | 0.950 | +0.063 |
| E05 | 0.875 | 0.875 | 1.000 | 1.000 | 0.000 |
| **Avg** | **0.913** | **0.913** | **0.977** | **0.990** | **+0.013** |

Recall không đổi vì reranking chỉ đổi thứ tự, không thêm/xóa chunk; union token set giữ nguyên. Reranking không đủ khi evidence không được retrieve, query dùng từ đồng nghĩa mạnh, chunk bị cắt sai, hoặc false positive vẫn đứng đầu; khi đó cần sửa retriever, query expansion, metadata filters, hoặc chunking.
